label: Messy arrows — irregular contrast in a vendor video
commentary: In the thread's original examples (#1), the buyer—not Karl_K—described this Kashi-sourced stone as showing poorly organised arrows, many adjacent black facets and brightness displaced away from the centre. This is a useful illustration of how face-up organisation can look disorderly, but the observations are the author's visual impressions, not an expert technical diagnosis. The MP4 was already archived under #64; it is linked here for provenance, not represented as a locally published reference video.
